_desc: Need help with WoW Train? Get support for the AI train planner, booking links, and travel essentials for your European train trip.
b2: WoW Train is built by a small team. We respond to every message, usually within 24 hours.
b4: For bug reports, feature requests, or anything else — send us an email. Include which browser and page you were on if reporting a bug.
b6: Which countries does WoW Train cover?
b7: Rail travel across 16 European countries, and we're expanding coverage regularly. If a route isn't showing yet, try describing it differently or check back soon.
b8: How do I book my train tickets?
b9: WoW Train doesn't sell tickets directly. Once the AI builds your itinerary, each leg links out to Omio, our booking partner, where you compare prices and complete the purchase securely.
b10: Do you store my personal data?
b11: WoW Train doesn't require an account. We use standard analytics to understand traffic — see our Privacy Policy for details.
b12: I found a bug — how do I report it?
b13: Email us at contact@glosx.app with a description of what happened, which browser you used, and the page you were on. Screenshots are always helpful.
